## Households

Practice mutual understanding as a learnable skill at your own table: charitable interpretation as the house rule, one small facilitated conversation across a real divide this month (invite them to dinner — embodied beats threaded), and connection as the household's first response to a struggling member, remembering that the opposite of addiction is not sobriety but connection.
